summary: Iteration 12 backend testing: threaded comments, @mentions + /users/search, and admin CSV import for quiz items. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_threads_mentions_import.py with 24 pytest cases covering every scenario in the review request, plus regression on previously-shipped endpoints. All 24/24 tests passed against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://ballgame-id.preview.emergentagent.com).

minor.issue: Endpoint is public (no auth) — intentional per spec. Not an issue, flagged for awareness: anyone can enumerate users by prefix with limit<=20. No sensitive fields (email) returned, only user_id/name/picture/short_code.

csv.Sniffer uses only the first line; works for the semicolon + BOM cases tested, but a CSV whose header is comma-based while body is semicolon-based would mis-parse (edge case — not required by spec).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2187 lines — >700 line guideline exceeded. Consider splitting into routers (news, quiz_items, matches, auth, social) in a future iteration.

Threaded-comment depth flattening (lines 1666-1673) correctly resolves grand-parent -> top-level ancestor and keeps notifications pointing at the real parent author. Verified by test_depth_cap_reply_to_reply_flattens.
Mention self-dedup via the `notified` set (line 1713) correctly suppresses self-mentions and double-pings. Verified by test_explicit_mentions_notify_targets_not_self.

CSV import correctly: (a) handles UTF-8 BOM via decode('utf-8-sig'), (b) accepts ; or , delimiters, (c) rejects image_url that isn't http(s)/ /api/, (d) appends order_index starting at max+1. All verified.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures seed per-module admin + 2 non-admin users + 1 user named 'Alice_<hex>' with a 'ali<hex>' short_code directly in Mongo (users + user_sessions). All TEST_-prefixed data is cleaned up via module-scoped fixture teardowns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 12 pytest file is at /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_threads_mentions_import.py and can be reused as regression. BASE_URL fixture is 'base_url' from conftest.py (reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Admin + 2 non-admin + 1 Alice user are module-scoped fixtures. The admin CSV import endpoint returns 200 with {created, skipped, errors, items} even when all rows are invalid; only truly empty uploads 400 and missing-columns header 422.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Every spec item in the review request behaves as described.
